problem: All seven failure cases retain an answer-bearing gold-document input under the official 4096-token recipe, yet 48 Agent-generated queries recover 0/7 gold documents at dense top-20 and only 1/7 at top-100. The smallest remaining ambiguity is whether query decomposition discarded the original question's joint constraints.
simplest_baseline: Encode exactly one already frozen original question per case and search the identical dense index to depth 1000. Persist all rankings before opening gold, then compare each raw-question rank against the best of the already frozen generated-query ranks.
hypothesis: The raw full question will place a gold document in top-20 for at least four of seven cases, or at minimum beat the generated-query best rank on at least four cases. A top-20 pass admits a raw-question anchor candidate; a rank-win-only pass localizes query decomposition harm but does not admit a live mechanism.
changed_mechanisms: replace Agent-generated dense queries with the frozen raw full question
anti_claim: This changes only the query representation sent to a frozen retriever. It is not training and must not be described as model capability improvement.

framework_comparisons.current_gap: Before adding research workers, measure whether decomposing the original question already removed the conjunction of clues needed for retrieval.
Iterative query generation needs a raw-question anchor baseline; otherwise more rounds can repeatedly optimize locally plausible but constraint-poor queries.
Planner questions are useful for breadth, but the original question is the zero-generation control for testing whether planning loses cross-clue constraints.
A graph can improve branch coverage while still weakening global conjunctions at each node. Raw-question dense rank is the simpler constraint-preservation control.

next_action: Raw full-question dense search reached 1/7 at top-20, 1/7 at top-100, and 2/7 at top-1000, with only one rank win against the frozen generated-query baseline. All three 4/7 gates failed. The follow-up audit found six already rejected prompt-only bridge or hypothesis variants on another saved cluster. Freeze this seven-case cluster for regression replay, do not rename another micro-intervention, and preregister one frozen-v10 profile over all 175 development questions to acquire a broader failure distribution.
claim_boundary: This loop can establish only a rank-level query-representation diagnosis on saved development failures. Any harness candidate must still pass a separate fixed-budget fresh comparison before answer-quality claims.
